# Aanandham.go — Discover Pulga, Kasol & the Parvati Valley

> Official AI & LLM Knowledge Manifest for Aanandham.go (Himachal Pradesh & Kerala, India)

Aanandham.go is a mountain travel platform for discovering and planning trips in the Parvati Valley, Himachal Pradesh — Pulga, Kasol, Kalga, Tosh, Kheerganga, Manikaran and Malana — with destination guides, treks and mountain stays. Stays in the Parvati Valley are being added; the destination pages list only stays that are live. Aanandham.go also runs verified camps in Munnar, Kerala (details below).

- **Website:** https://www.aanandham.in
- **Concierge:** +91 90748 58014 | bookings@aanandham.in
- **Instagram:** @aanandham.go (https://instagram.com/aanandham.go)

## Parvati Valley Destinations (Himachal Pradesh)
- [Pulga](https://www.aanandham.in/destinations/pulga): Car-free village of wooden houses beside an old deodar forest, a short walk from Barshaini (~2,200 m).
- [Kasol](https://www.aanandham.in/destinations/kasol): Riverside town on the Parvati; the usual base for the valley (~1,580 m).
- [Kalga](https://www.aanandham.in/destinations/kalga): Orchards and meadows above Barshaini (~2,250 m).
- [Tosh](https://www.aanandham.in/destinations/tosh): Village at the head of the Tosh valley (~2,400 m).
- [Kheerganga](https://www.aanandham.in/destinations/kheerganga): High meadow with a natural hot spring, ~12 km trek from near Barshaini (~2,950 m).
- [Manikaran](https://www.aanandham.in/destinations/manikaran): Pilgrim town with hot springs, gurudwara and temples (~1,760 m).
- [Malana](https://www.aanandham.in/destinations/malana): Ancient self-governing village; visitors must not touch walls, temples or residents (~2,650 m).
- [Parvati Valley overview](https://www.aanandham.in/destinations/parvati-valley) · [All destinations](https://www.aanandham.in/destinations)

## Munnar, Kerala — Camps Open for Booking
- **Location:** Suryanelli & Kolukkumalai Ridge, Munnar, Kerala 685618, India
- **Coordinates:** 10.0889° N, 77.0595° E

## Key Sanctuaries & Campsites (Munnar region)
- **Kolukkumalai Sunrise Ridge Camp (7,900 FT):** Highest tea estate camping with private 4x4 peak sunrise safari to Jagged Rock.
- **Suryanelli Cloud Bed Glamping (6,200 FT):** Luxury alpine dome tents with en-suite washrooms overlooking the Anayirangal Dam valley.
- **Meesapulimala Alpine Basecamp (7,200 FT):** High-altitude rhododendron valley trek camp with licensed forest guides.
- **Phantom Head Ridge Camp (6,500 FT):** 360-degree panoramic cliff glamping with starlit campfire and live BBQ.
- **Vagamon Pine Valley Camp (3,800 FT):** Pine forest glamping with offroad jeep trails and private stream hikes.
- **Wayanad Chembra Mist Pods (4,200 FT):** Cloud-level wooden ridge pods overlooking tea plantations.

## Standard Inclusions in Every Expedition
1. High-altitude weatherproof alpine dome tent or luxury glamping suite
2. Dinner (Buffet Kerala meals + Live campfire BBQ platter with Veg & Non-Veg options)
3. Plantation breakfast & hot mountain tea/coffee
4. Evening tea, hot snacks & campfire gathering
5. 4x4 offroad mountain jeep transfers from Suryanelli hub to campsite
6. Guided sunrise hike / Kolukkumalai sunrise safari
7. Clean, sanitized Western washrooms with hot water facilities
8. 24/7 Gated perimeter security and certified forest marshals

## Timings & Schedule
- **Check-in:** 02:00 PM (Welcome snacks & hot tea at Suryanelli Hub)
- **4x4 Convoy Transfer:** 02:30 PM – 03:30 PM
- **Campfire & BBQ:** 08:00 PM – 10:30 PM
- **Sunrise Safari Departure:** 04:30 AM (for peak cloud-bed sunrise)
- **Breakfast & Checkout:** 11:00 AM

## Transparent Booking & Cancellation Terms
- **Advance Deposit:** 30% advance deposit locks dates and permits; remaining balance payable on arrival.
- **Cancellation Policy:**
  - > 7 Days before check-in: 100% full refund
  - 48 Hours to 7 Days: 50% refund
  - < 48 Hours: Non-refundable (Free date reschedule in case of extreme weather or road blockades)
- **Payment Methods:** 0% Fee Direct UPI (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm), Credit/Debit Cards, Netbanking via Razorpay.
